proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {i, j, k} := by decide +revert
  have hc : t.ninePointCircle.center = midpoint ℝ t.circumcenter t.orthocenter := by
    apply vsub_left_injective t.circumcenter |>.eq_iff.mp
    rw [t.ninePointCircle_center, vadd_vsub, midpoint_vsub]
    have : t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.circumcenter = (3 : ℝ) • (t.centroid -ᵥ t.circumcenter) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [t.orthocenter_eq_smul_vsub_vadd_circumcenter, vadd_vsub]
    rw [this, vsub_self, smul_zero, zero_add, smul_smul]
    norm_num
  have hr : t.ninePointCircle.radius = t.circumradius / 2 := by
    rw [t.ninePointCircle_radius]
    norm_num
  have key : ∀ x : P, x ∈ t.ninePointCircle → dist x (midpoint ℝ t.circumcenter t.orthocenter) = t.circumradius / 2 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← hc, ← hr]
    exact EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mp hx
  refine ⟨key _ ?_, key _ (t.altitudeFoot_mem_ninePointCircle i), key _ ?_⟩
  · have hF := t.faceOppositeCentroid_mem_ninePointCircle i
    have hF2 : t.faceOppositeCentroid i = midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k) := by
      have h := t.faceOppositeCentroid_eq_sum_vsub_vadd i
      rw [hu, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hij, hik]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hjk]), Finset.sum_singleton, vsub_self, zero_add] at h
      rw [h]
      apply vsub_left_injective (t.points i) |>.eq_iff.mp
      rw [vadd_vsub, midpoint_vsub]
      simp only [invOf_eq_inv]
      norm_num
    rwa [hF2] at hF
  · rw [← Affine.Triangle.eulerPoint_eq_midpoint]
    exact t.eulerPoint_mem_ninePointCircle i
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → dist (midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k)) (midpoint ℝ t.circumcenter t.orthocenter) = t.circumradius / 2 ∧ dist (t.altitudeFoot i) (midpoint ℝ t.circumcenter t.orthocenter) = t.circumradius / 2 ∧ dist (midpoint ℝ t.orthocenter (t.points i)) (midpoint ℝ t.circumcenter t.orthocenter) = t.circumradius / 2
